categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 12/13 scoped local checklist items passed; see findings/technical.md

findings.title: Configured domain is a sale/parking destination
findings.description: Authenticated HTTPS fetch of promarketing.com returned a 114-byte JavaScript redirect to /lander. Following /lander reached a GoDaddy domain-for-sale page. The PROMARK build is not deployed there. This is not proof about who owns the domain.
findings.recommendation: Verify ownership and DNS access, or choose a domain you control. Do not claim the build is live or submit its sitemap at this domain until the correct website is served.

findings.title: Native form fallback conflicts with security policy
findings.description: With JavaScript disabled, Chromium blocks the form’s mailto submission because the Node server sets CSP form-action to self. Reproduced without sending email; direct email links remain usable.
findings.recommendation: Permit the intended mailto action in the serving policy, or use a non-submitting email/WhatsApp fallback. Recheck with JavaScript disabled.

findings.title: Enquiry submission depends on the visitor’s mail app
findings.description: The form prepares an email draft and cannot confirm delivery. It is clearly labelled, and email, phone and WhatsApp alternatives are real. This is a conversion limitation, not an indexing penalty.
findings.recommendation: If reliable in-page submission is required, configure a server-side mail service with validation, accessible error handling and verified success states.

findings.title: Sites connector tools unavailable
findings.description: The user tagged Sites, but the active tool catalog exposed no callable Sites tools or matching app capabilities.
findings.recommendation: Reconnect or enable Sites for this conversation if further work must use that app; do not invent a publication or connector result.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 7/10 scoped local checklist items passed; see findings/content.md

findings.title: Case studies lack first-hand detail
findings.description: Three real cases show client assets and state the objective/deliverables, but do not explain actual SEO/GEO tasks, creative decisions, constraints or validation. Main text is approximately 126–189 words per case; length itself is not the failure.
findings.recommendation: Add the genuine client brief, your role, specific decisions and delivered changes. Use approved before/after evidence and verified outcomes only.

findings.title: Services and practitioner detail are limited
findings.description: The Services page covers four services on one URL. About explains values/location, with limited approved who/how detail. No SERP mismatch was demonstrated.
findings.recommendation: Enrich the most important service with decision-useful examples and scope. Add a truthful practitioner introduction. Create separate service pages only after intent research and enough distinct material.

findings.title: Original logo is absent from the Organization graph
findings.description: The SVG is rendered in the site but is not referenced as Organization.logo. No JSON-LD parsing failure was found.
findings.recommendation: Connect a suitable, accessible original-logo image after checking actual-host requirements. Do not redraw the logo.

findings.title: No responsive raster variants
findings.description: Posters are already compact at about 27–84kB, but mobile cards use the same 1280px landscape files.
findings.recommendation: Consider smaller srcset variants and efficient formats where actual savings justify maintenance.

categories.name: Performance (field CWV)
what_works: Local unthrottled lab observations are recorded separately.

findings.title: Field performance not measured
findings.description: No real-user production data or Lighthouse score available.

findings.title: Small secondary link hit areas
findings.description: Some mobile footer link boxes are 16–22px tall. Spacing and inline exceptions have not been fully evaluated; this is not a declared WCAG failure.
findings.recommendation: Increase padding/hit area of footer and breadcrumb links; preserve spacing and visible focus states.

findings.title: Production performance and search outcomes unmeasured
findings.description: No deployed PROMARK host, CrUX/GSC access, Lighthouse installation or measured AI citations were available. Local lab timings do not establish field CWV.
findings.recommendation: After deployment, measure mobile field CWV, indexing, rich-result eligibility and search/AI visibility; record a baseline.

phases.name: 1. Resolve launch blocker
items: Verify an owned domain and its DNS/hosting access.
Serve the correct production build over HTTPS.
Retest live canonicals, robots, sitemap and redirects before requesting indexing.

phases.name: 2. Improve reliability and evidence
items: Choose whether to implement server-side enquiry delivery.
Add real case-specific process details and approved practitioner information.

phases.name: 3. Refine and measure
items: Improve secondary touch targets; optionally connect the logo graph and responsive images.
Verify rich-result eligibility, crawl/index coverage and field CWV.
Research service search intent and measure actual search/AI visibility.

limits: No live PROMARK indexation or authority score
No field CWV or INP measurement
